free_tier.stated: Free - 3 active tunnels - Any subdomain - 1 reserved subdomain - 0 custom domains - 1 access key - HTTP Inspector - UDP requires a paid plan. All plans include: No request or bandwidth limits - No session timeout - HTTP and TCP tunnels (UDP on paid plans).

egress.terms: No request or bandwidth limits on any plan, and no session timeout.; ingress: tcp

interface_detail: shubhamtun http 3000 --domain myapp, shubhamtun tcp 22, shubhamtun udp 25565.
tooling: curl -fsSL https://tun.shubham-dev.in/install.sh | sh; CLI and desktop app.
chaining: Free TCP tunnel with no byte cap could front a WireGuard-over-TCP wrapper, but not native WireGuard.

limits.value: UDP requires a paid plan, cheapest listed at $80/month (Base)
3 active tunnels and 1 access key on Free

binding_note: The free tier has no UDP listener at all; the first UDP packet requires the $80/month Base plan, so volume is irrelevant to this workload.

identity_cost.detail: Sign in with GitHub or Google, then generate an API token: shubhamtun login --token sk_xxxxx. No card is mentioned for the free plan.

reliability_note: No session timeout claimed on any plan; the service is small and its pricing jumped from a $2.50/mo entry to $80/mo for UDP, which suggests repricing risk.
confidence_note: The pricing block rendered only in the search-index copy of the vendor page, not in the extracted body; a rendered read or a signup walk would confirm it at the same rung.

evidence.proved: Free: 3 active tunnels, any subdomain, 1 reserved subdomain, 1 access key, UDP requires a paid plan; no request or bandwidth limits; TCP on free, UDP on paid.

notes: A single-developer service with a $80/month Base plan, which is expensive for the category. Free TCP with no bandwidth limit is the interesting part; UDP is not reachable at zero cost.

extras.wg_detail: UDP is a paid-plan protocol: the free plan carries HTTP and TCP only, and the UDP command (shubhamtun udp 25565) is gated behind Base at $80/month.
extras.volume_stated: No request or bandwidth limits on any plan, and no session timeout.
extras.transit_note: The vendor relay terminates TLS and forwards to the local agent.
